text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll read this book today. Hehe,
the
demon-slaying legends in the Heian
period, eh...
Hm, If I were a character in
one of these tales...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'd quite like to be a warrior of the
Minamoto clan
who commands the
demon-slaying army. I
suppose that
would mean I'd have to don battle

armor, but I'd prefer to wear my
signature
racewear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And if I wished to slay the strongest
demon out
there, I would have to
prepare thoroughly! First, I
would have
to arrange for war councils—

Oh, there you are, Ardan! You've gotta
help me
out! Can you tutor me on
history? Pleeease?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello there, Palmer. Is everything all
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So, actually, I have a test on the Heian
period in
history class tomorrow, and I'm
freaking out!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Help me out, too, Prof! History's low-key

impossible to understand! The yikes are
off the
charts!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'd be happy to teach you both.
You
actually came at a perfect time
since this book
I'm reading at the
moment is set during the Heian
period.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Learning the historical setting will help
familiarize
you with the era, so let me
start by sharing this
book's legends of
demon vanquishers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If you try imagining yourself as someone
who
lived during this time period, it'll be
much easier
to get a better
understanding of it.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So we should act like demon slayers?
That sounds
straight fire!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let's put our imaginations to work.
Envision
yourselves as two of the four
masters
accompanying Minamoto no
Yorimitsu—the
samurai tasked with
eradicating the demons—and
we're on
our way to the demons' mountain hideout.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Palmer, you're Watanabe no Tsuna, the
mighty
and renowned leader of the four
masters. And
Helios, would you like to
assume the role of
Sakata no Kintoki, or
Kintaro, as he's better
known?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm Kintaro?! Waheeey, we stan a
demon-slaying
battle axe king! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Okay, got it! So, right now, we're on our
way to
climb the mountain and storm the
demons'
hideout! Right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Now, I, Yorimitsu, shall humbly
take
command. Come, Tsuna and
Kintoki! The time has
come to march on
and vanquish these demons!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Although, said demons are doubtless on
the
watch for us, so we must adopt
disguises to avoid
inviting suspicion.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oop, if we're trying not to look sus, I
guess I
should prolly hide my axe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we'd best hide our weapons. Given
the era
and the fact that we're in the
mountains, the most
natural guise for us
to adopt would be that of
some
yamabushi.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Yamabushi?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, "yamabushi" refers to both
miracle-working
Shugendo monks who
travel about the mountains
as well as
those currently training to become such

monks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Training of that sort was very popular at
the time,
so trainees were akin to
travelers and were quite
a common sight
in the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? "Shu...gen...do"? Uhh... Okay, so
we just
have to dress up like travelers,
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Brace yourselves, demons. I, Yorimitsu,
am on my
way to cut you down with my
trusty Onikirimaru!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Onigiri maru"? Wait, why are we talking about rice balls? Is the plan to get their attention with some bussin' snacks or something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, I'm referring to my weapon, not
to food.
Onikirimaru is a sword said to
have slain countless
demons and
monsters. It's an invaluable treasure
of
the Minamoto clan, and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold up! I can't stop thinking
about onigiri
now... Gah, I'm so
confused!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear some rowdy voices coming from
the corner
of the cafeteria, and when I
look over, I see
Mejiro Ardan looking
slightly troubled over
something...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear, it seems our visualization
exercise has
fallen apart. Perhaps my
manner of speaking
made things too
difficult to understand...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Palmer, Helios, and I were using our
imaginations
to delve into history and
learn more about it, but
things didn't go
as well as I'd hoped...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's a good idea. There's no use in
forcing
ourselves to continue since our
concentration is
already broken. Thank
you for your advice.
choice_data_list: 別の勉強方法を試すとか
choice_data_list_en: Why not take a quick break?
Or try a different way of studying?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a short break, you two. And
since
talking about Onikirimaru
reminded you of
onigiri, why don't we
enjoy some together?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally down! Hey, I wonder if we can
shape
some onigiri into a sword to make
a legit
Onigirimaru! Let's give it a try! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Now you're cooking, Helios!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The trio take a breather and enjoy
making some
cute sword-shaped onigiri
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, perhaps that'd be best. Palmer,
Helios. It
seems using our imaginations
to learn is harder
than I expected, so
shall we try using a more
orthodox
method to study instead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, sorry, Ardan! I just don't know
enough
about ye olde times to be able
to picture all that
stuff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That's quite all right. We have a
fair idea of
what the test will cover, so
I'll start by going over
the most
important points.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Omigosh, thank you so much! At this
point I guess
our only option is to
memorize everything!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
All right! Time to cram everything into
my brain!
...Nooo, all the words are super
hard! I'm crashing
ooout!
